description: A precise metronome with WebAudio clicks — set any BPM, beats per bar and subdivision, with tap tempo and a visual pulse.

faqs.a: Timing uses the Web Audio clock (lookahead scheduling), which is far more accurate than setInterval.
Yes — tap the Tap button at least 3 times and the BPM is set from your taps.
Beat 1 gets a higher accent click; you can set 0–12 beats per bar.
Yes — works on desktop and mobile browsers.

howto: Set the BPM with the slider or tap tempo.
Choose beats per bar and note subdivision.
Press Start — follow the clicks and the flashing beat dot.
